title: Extract Domain
prompt: An analytics report stores full URLs but wants only the domain. Write a function that removes an optional http:// or https:// prefix and returns everything before the first slash.

explanation.beginner:
Example: extractDomain("https://example.com/posts/1") produces "example.com". The result must follow this precise rule: An analytics report stores full URLs but wants only the domain. Write a function that removes an optional http:// or https:// prefix and returns everything before the first slash. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “extracts http domains”: input ["http://localhost:3000/path"] produces "localhost:3000". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
